title: 2026 exempt-HFC labelling, direct-sale and reporting QA

sources.title: Uses of F gas (HFCs) exempt from the phase down
Labelling F gas equipment you produce, import or install

facts.source_fact: Containers of exempt HFCs must be labelled.
The exempt-HFC label must state which exemption the gas will be used for.
Exempt-HFC containers must also meet the other applicable F-gas labelling requirements.
HFCs remain exempt when sold directly to the business or organisation carrying out the exempt activity.
HFCs do not remain exempt when sold to an organisation not carrying out exempt activities, even if later used for an exempt activity.
All exempt uses of HFCs that are imported or produced must be reported.
Exemption from phase-down quota does not mean exemption from labelling.
facts.expected_handling: Keep quota and label rules separate.

facts.source_fact: Exemption from phase-down quota does not mean exemption from reporting.
facts.expected_handling: Keep quota and reporting rules separate.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 guidance update clarified export and labelling rules for exempt HFCs.
Reported exempt-use status is not a parcel-level emissions measurement.
